# H6008 — host colour frames, docs/protocol/ble.md 8.
# Captured 2026-09-12 on a macOS host, over the write characteristic of
# docs/protocol/ble.md 1.1, write without response. The notify characteristic
# of the same section was subscribed throughout and answered none of these
# writes. What each frame rendered was watched on the bulb.
#
# The frames carry no identity: no MAC, no address, no account. The peripheral
# handle the host addressed is a per-host identifier and is left out.
#
# > client -> device      < device -> client

> a50283ff000029          # red
> a5028300ff0029          # green
> a502830000ff29          # blue
> a50283ffffff27          # cold white
> a5028300280052          # a dim green
> a502830000002a          # dark. The bulb stayed on, read back over lan
> a50283ff00ff2a          # magenta. Held after the link went down, then the
                          # firmware returned to its stored state after over a
                          # minute
